translations.web: They have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, “Peace, peace,” when there is no peace.
translations.bsb: They dress the wound of the daughter of My people with very little care, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there is no peace at all.
translations.kjv: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
translations.asv: And they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
